# Geekflare

> Geekflare is a collaborative AI workspace and developer API platform offering 40+ LLM models, web scraping, and enterprise automation tools.

Geekflare provides both AI-powered collaboration tools and comprehensive APIs for data extraction, web scraping, and security scanning. The platform integrates with OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, and other leading AI providers, serving developers and businesses seeking unified AI strategy and RAG-ready data extraction.

## Key Topics

- Geekflare AI

## Core Products

- [Geekflare AI | Unify Your Business AI Strategy](https://geekflare.com/ai): Unified platform integrating 40+ LLM models from OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic for collaborative AI workflows.
- [Geekflare Connect | BYOK AI Workspace for Teams](https://geekflare.com/ai/connect): Bring-Your-Own-Key AI workspace for team collaboration with 65% cost savings and unified model access.
- [Geekflare API - Scrape, Screenshot & Extract RAG Context](https://geekflare.com/api): Comprehensive API suite for web scraping, screenshot capture, and data extraction optimized for LLM RAG pipelines.
- [Geekflare Tools for Business Growth](https://geekflare.com/tools): Free productivity tools suite designed for business optimization and workflow automation.

## API Reference & Documentation

- [Geekflare API Docs - Geekflare](https://docs.geekflare.com/api): Complete API documentation covering REST endpoints, authentication, rate limits, and integration guides.
- [Geekflare AI Docs - Geekflare](https://docs.geekflare.com/ai): AI platform documentation with getting started guides, system requirements, and setup instructions.
- [Web Scraping API - Extract HTML, Markdown & LLM Data](https://geekflare.com/api/webscraping): Web scraping API reference with HTML/Markdown extraction, CAPTCHA handling, and proxy rotation capabilities.
- [Geekflare API Collection | Scraping, Screenshots, Security & SEO APIs](https://geekflare.com/api/collection): Complete API collection overview including scraping, screenshots, DNS, and security scanning endpoints.
